title: Baa Juice Strawberry Cherry Raspberry Shortfill 100ml E-Liquid
description: Baa Juice Strawberry Cherry Raspberry Shortfill blends three berry favourites into one rich vape. Strawberry sets the tone with its sweet, summery flavour, Cherry brings a juicy depth, and Raspberry adds a tangy lift. Together they create a balanced berry mix that stays vibrant from first puff to last. Supplied in a 120ml bottle with 100ml of nicotine-free e-liquid, there’s space for two nic shots if required. Blended at 50/50 ratio, this Shortfill is designed for MTL pod kits to produce a balanced vaping style with vibrant flavour. Baa Juice Shortfills use double-concentrated flavouring, ensuring a fruit blend that’s bold, well-defined and long-lasting.
